en: I wish you the best of luck, sir.
How to Play '01 Games
The players attempt to reduce their score from a fixed number until they reach exactly zero.
You bust if you go under zero, at which point your opponent gets to play. Your points will revert to what they were when the round started.
The first player to reach exactly zero at the end of the assigned number of rounds wins.
If neither player can reach zero during the allotted rounds, the player with fewer remaining points is declared the winner.
In '01 Games, both the outer and inner bull are worth 50 points.
How to Play Cricket
In cricket, only the numbers 15 through 20 and the bull's-eye are used.
Singles count as one hit, Doubles count as two hits, and Triples count as three hits.
Three hits on a number closes it.
The points from subsequent hits on a number you closed are added to your score.
When all rounds are concluded, the player with the higher score is declared the winner.
However, the game will also end if all numbers are closed before the end of the assigned number of rounds, and the player with the higher score is declared the winner.
How to Play Random Cricket
Unlike standard cricket, random cricket uses the bullseye and six randomly selected numbers.
The points from subsequent hits on a number you closed are added to your score.
How to Play Hidden Cricket
Unlike standard cricket, hidden cricket uses seven hidden numbers.
The seven numbers are hidden at the start of the game and are not revealed until they are hit by a player.
Players who reveal a hidden number by hitting it for the first time receive an open bonus.
Hitting numbers in the single ring counts as one hit, the double ring as two hits, and the triple ring as three hits.

It's incredible!

Honestly, I wasn't sure what to expect. I know it's a local favorite, but I was worried it might end up tasting like every other stew that's out there.
But this is on a whole new level. This chicken broth is fantastic. The flavors are all in harmony. I bet they work hard to get it like this.

Driver, I can't thank you enough for taking me here!
Oh, sure... Glad you're enjoying yourself.
(...At least in here, no one can hear him call me by name.)

...And boy, did I run into a fiasco in India! How'd they
expect me to know⑬ Hey, are you listening, Kiryu-san?
Oh, uh, yeah. How have you been?
You know me, man. Busy as a globetrotting bumblebee, looking for all those perfect shots.
How would you define a perfect shot?

Let me tell you like this. It's when a scene catches your
eye, and next thing you know, it sucks you into a trance.
Something so powerful, it gives you a Revelation.
A Revelation, huh...

You betcha. See, when someone's got a Revelation, it means
their brain is going on overdrive. That hyped-up mode of
thinking unlocks new powers within.

Not to toot my own horn, but as a photographic phenom, it's
my mission in life to compile as many groundbreaking,
breathtaking, Revelation-triggering snapshots as possible!
Yeah... I remember you saying something like that when we last met.
Oh for sure. You helped me out a ton back then, remember?
Did I?
Of course! All those super-wicked shots you sent me changed my life! And I don't say that lightly.
Though lately, you haven't sent me a thing.
That was a bitter pill to swallow, seeing all that premium Kiryu content dwindle down to nothingness in my inbox. My emotional life was impacted.
Sorry about that... As you can see, I've been a bit busy.

Ah, don't worry, it's cool. All water under the bridge!
You can always start fresh when it comes to finding perfect
shots⑬so let's make some new Revelations on the double!
Aww, don't tell me you forgot how!
Well hey. That's no problem.
I'm sure my ultra-bestie Kiryu-san can retrain himself to snap up perfect pictures in no time!
Ooh, let me out here, please!
We're offering a little contest here for couples who play together. Would you care to try it out?
Throw the dart at the wheel. The color you hit determines the prize you win!
If you hit the bull's-eye, you win the gray prize!
Your lady friend will have to work extra hard for some of these prizes. What do you say?

Ugh... He got us good...
And so, I single-handedly sent those delinquents packing, thus proving my manliness and passionate love for Kaguya-chan!
All right, I think that's enough.
But there's more! All of a sudden I saw...
Lights out in five minutes!
Aw man, it's bedtime?
Guess we have to call it a night.
Well, how'd you like that, Saejima-san?
Really feels like I ate somethin'. Weird.
Weird? It should feel great! A beautiful woman and a tasty meal. Ah, with any luck, we'll be enjoying the real thing soon.
So there I was, happily stuffed full of food, when a problem arose.
Yeah. Just as I got to this intersection, a horde of punks swarmed the place.
You heard me, a bunch of punks! Imagine them, please. Imagine hard!
How d'ya expect me to...?
Oh, okay. Imagination's more powerful than I thought. But why's this happening, exactly?
You mean why <Italic>did</Italic> it happen. It was over Kaguya-chan. The leader of this little gang was in love with her.
So he brought his stooges to rough you up? Sounds cheesy.
Hey, you! Asshole! The only cheesy guy here is you, 'cause you're the rat who's been bothering my girl!
This happened? He'd hafta do this to every customer.
No, no, not every customer. Just me, because I hit it off so well with Kaguya-chan and had that karaoke date.
Ya sure 'bout that?
Of course I am! Anyway there I was, staring death in the face. And I grinned right back.
What the hell are you smiling at? Guys, let's stomp this little weasel!
The boss was shouting! The punks were edging closer! But I calmly struck a fighting pose...
Brawlin' ain't really what I wanted to do in my 'magination. I get enough of this in real life.
And so, I had a wonderful karaoke date with darling Kaguya-chan. How'd you like it? Did you picture it in your mind?
Been a while since I talked to a woman. But it was a good time, even if imaginary...
Glad to hear it!
So, after all that fun, I was just famished. I decided to go have a meal.
Suddenly, hunger welled up out of nowhere!
Food, huh? Nothin' around here looks any good, though.
Nonsense, there are loads of good places to eat in Tsukimino.
My go-to joint is Matsuo Lamb Barbeque for some mutton hot pot.
But if you're not that hungry, you can get a small bite and drink at Gindaco Highball Tavern.
And if you're still hungry for female company, there's Izakaya Hanako as well.
Hm, where did I go on this particular night? Uh, let's just imagine eating wherever Saejima chooses.
Mutton BBQ, takoyaki, or a pub. Any of 'em sound pretty good. Hm...
Thank you for waiting. Where shall we go?
I dunno. Not familiar with the neighborhood.
Come on, man! Karaoke! Where else would you go on a date?
Uh... How about karaoke?
Oh, I haven't done that in quite a while! I'd love to!
Here's the club! Looks cool, huh?
Looks expensive, is what I was gonna say. You could afford a joint like this?
Heheh. At one point in my life, I had ten million yen to play with. Ah, those were the days...
You're shittin' me. Ten mil?
Oh yeah. I might not look it, but I used to be a real high roller.
Go ahead, pretend you've got oodles of yen burning a damn hole in your pocket. You need to party hard tonight!
10 million yen <Color:8>appeared in your wallet<Color:Default>.
Hey, that wasn't hard to imagine.
There you go! Doesn't it feel spectacular to be loaded with cash? Like anything's possible?
That's how I felt as I went into the club...
So this is Tsukimino?
Yup. Gorgeous, right?
Can't tell. I can only imagine a little of it from your map.
No problem! I'll tell you a story from when I was there⑬that'll fill in the gaps in your imagination!
Uh, I don't get it, but okay.
Where to begin? I know! I'll tell you about a time I visited a hostess club.
The club was in the south part of town. On Lavender Street!
All right. I'll just... imagine myself walking there, I guess.
But I'm not wearin' the right duds for it...
That's better. Been too long since I wore this.
Okay, off we go! Lavender Street awaits.
Oh, it's Gindaco Highball Tavern. In there you can snack on piping-hot takoyaki and wash it down with the best highballs in town. How about it?
How 'bout we look somewhere else?
Sure, I miss takoyaki.
Excellent! Let's go in.
This is Izakaya Hanako, a place where you can get some female companionship besides Kaguya-chan. You'd like that, eh? Hehe, I get you Saejima-san!
Sure, prison definitely don't have what they're offerin'.
Right? It's killing me! Let's go in.
Here we are: Matsuo Lamb Barbeque. When it comes to dining in Hokkaido, you can't go wrong with mutton BBQ.
Yeah, I could go for that.
You won't be sorry!
*slurp* *gulp* Damn, this is good!
What a meal!
And so, I once again saved the town from peril! Applause, please!
Whoops. Come on, Saejima-san, get it together!
Huh. A missin' chunk of imagination feels weird.
Well, even though Saejima-san got whupped, I once again saved the town from peril. Applause, please!
Mighty heroic of ya. But come on, all this talk of bein' a former detective, it's all a pack a' lies, right?
I would never! How can you accuse me of such a thing?
Heh. Whatever, man.
Nothin'. This was fun. Think that's enough, though.
Alrighty!
Yup, they were well-aware of being tailed.
So, what'd ya do?
You really need to ask? I fought them! To protect the town.
Hah! What a load! But fine, let's do this.
You did exactly what I did! I too deftly sidestepped their insidious car-attack!
Come on, Saejima-san, get it together! When they came at me like that, I stepped aside with a flourish.
Hah, more of your horse dung.
And I knew my near-death experience wasn't a coincidence. They were aware of my tailing them.
But still, I refused to be intimidated, for I was an officer of the law. I resolved to protect the town and bring honor to my proud and noble profession!
Weren't ya busted for corruption?
Ouch. That's a sore point, boss. Come on, let's keep after those mobsters!
At some point while I was chasing the mafia, I entered an intersection. Suddenly...!
